sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Pseudotaxus chienii is a dioecious evergreen coniferous shrub that can reach about 4 m. It is native to China and grows in forested mountain habitats.

sections.title: Leaves and seed
sections.text: Its linear leaves are about 1–2.6 cm long and 2–4.5 mm wide. The seed is partly enclosed by a white, cup-shaped aril about 5–7 mm long.

sections.title: Food and caution
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish a safe food use for this species. Its aril should not be assumed edible from comparisons with other yews.
